title: Rising prices remain top concern of Filipinos, says OCTA Research survey
summary: Rising prices are the top concern among Filipinos, according to the latest survey by OCTA Research, according to a report in "24 Oras."

blocks.text: Rising prices are the top concern among Filipinos, according to the latest survey by OCTA Research, according to a report in "24 Oras."
Forty-two percent said that the government's priority should be controlling the prices of goods and services.
That was also number one concern of Filipinos in July 2026, but the number of people worried over the hike in prices is 5% higher now.
And, 35% said they are concerned about adjusting and increasing workers' wages.
Meanwhile, fighting corruption in the government is the concern of 29% of Filipinos.
The survey was conducted from September 28 to October 4, 2026 with 1,200 respondents aged 18 and above. It has a margin of error of ± 3%, and a 95% confidence level. — BAP, GMA News
